reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Indirect management with GIZ/Enhancing Skills of Youth and Women in Catchments of Agro-Industrial Parks of Ethiopia

description.narrative: This Action refers to the component 4 of the Decision (PROSEAD project) which is designed to enhance skills of youth and women in the parks and their catchment areas and improve decent employment conditions, to be implemented by GIZ STEP II programme with a timeframe of 25 month from June 2019 to July 2021. The joint action will achieve the objective of component 4 by working in three output areas1. Skilled and unskilled workforce is adequately trained to work in and around the targeted AIPs2. Framework conditions for the decent work agenda are created in the targeted AIPs3.Incubators in targeted AIPs provide employment related servicesThe joint action will work with a mix of international and national experts, seconded personnel to the IAIPs, short- and long-term consultancies and financial contributions to national stakeholders to imbed the action into the national partner landscape. The joint action synergises parallel GIZ funding in the sectors Rural Development (Green Innovation Centres) and Education (Sustainable Training and Education Programme STEP).
